clips.speaker: Bloomberg
clips.title: 市场低估AI资本开支回报 策略师Amoroso称
title_lines: 市场低估AI资本开支回报
云收入增长与广告优化是亮点
title_highlights: 市场低估AI资本开支回报
云收入增长与广告优化是亮点

subtitles.en: Do you think that there is a real question now to whether these tech giants can continue to spend in the way that they are when it comes to AI and data centers?
subtitles.zh: 你认为科技巨头能否继续在AI和数据中心上如此投入？

subtitles.en: Is this the market trying to force them to pump the brakes? I mean, look, the market has been trying to force them.
subtitles.zh: 市场是在迫使他们踩刹车吗？市场一直在这么做。

subtitles.en: I would say over the course of the last year or maybe two years and all that keeps happening is they keep upgrading those capex expectations.
subtitles.zh: 过去一两年，他们不断上调资本支出预期。

subtitles.en: I think what the market is likely under appreciating, I think, are two things.
subtitles.zh: 我认为市场可能低估了两点。

subtitles.en: So first of all, is that there is an ROI on a lot of the spend that's being rolled out.
subtitles.zh: 首先，大量支出是有回报的。

subtitles.en: And the reason why you would spend $5, $600, $700 billion, I should say, into capex and data centers is because you're expecting to see your cloud revenues grow as a result
subtitles.zh: 投入5000-7000亿美元到资本支出和数据中心，是因为预期云收入会增长。

subtitles.en: of that. We're seeing that certainly from the hyperscalers. We also see, as we've talked about last time, the hyperscaler cloud backlog of a trillion and a half.
subtitles.zh: 超大规模云服务商确实如此，其云积压订单达1.5万亿。

subtitles.en: So all of those revenues are yet to be booked. So I do think that's one thing the markets are under appreciating.
subtitles.zh: 这些收入尚未入账，市场低估了这一点。

subtitles.en: The other is, there was an interesting point this morning about Amazon and how AI enablement of Amazon can actually allow them to be better at placing ads, to be better at product recommendations.
subtitles.zh: 另外，今早有观点认为AI赋能亚马逊，能优化广告投放和产品推荐。

subtitles.en: And so, actually, the companies like some of those same hyperscalers are going to benefit in the other parts of their business, whether it's digital advertising, whether it's e-commerce,
subtitles.zh: 这些超大规模云服务商的其他业务，如数字广告和电商，也将受益。

subtitles.en: whether it's social media, et cetera. So I think that's something that investors also should not lose sight of.
subtitles.zh: 无论是社交媒体等等。所以我认为这也是市场参与者不应忽视的。

subtitles.en: Does it, though, just make life more difficult when they sell off like this?
subtitles.zh: 但这样抛售是否会让情况更糟？
